---
title: "Claustrum Connectivity in Prematurity Specificity Analyses (dHCP)"
author: "Jil Wendt"
format: html
editor: visual
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

Specificity analyses for the neonatal group differences in claustrum CP (dHCP cohort; Supplementary control and robustness analyses, section 2). The group-comparison ANCOVA (CP \~ group + age at scan + sex) is repeated with additional covariates: (A) CP from the ipsilateral insula and/or putamen seed to the same target, (B) claustrum seed and/or target volume, (C) seed-to-target distance. FDR correction across the 22 target ROIs within each model. Group differences in insula- and putamen-seeded CP are tested with the same ANCOVA.

- Input: `data/dHCP_CP_control_volumes_distance.csv` (CP from claustrum, insula and putamen seeds, seed and target volumes, seed-to-target distances, demographics)
- Outputs (`outputs/tables`):
  - `Revision_control_group_diff_dHCP_<date>.csv`: insula and putamen CP, group comparison (results/control_seeds_groupcomp_dHCP.csv)
  - `Revision_specificity_ANCOVA_CP_dHCP_<date>.csv`, `Revision_specificity_survival_dHCP_<date>.csv`: control-seed models (results/specificity_seed_dHCP.csv, specificity_seed_survival_dHCP.csv)
  - `Revision_specificity_volume_ANCOVA_CP_dHCP_<date>.csv`, `Revision_specificity_volume_survival_dHCP_<date>.csv`: volume models (results/specificity_volume_dHCP.csv, specificity_volume_survival_dHCP.csv)
  - `Revision_specificity_distance_ANCOVA_CP_dHCP_<date>.csv`, `Revision_specificity_distance_survival_dHCP_<date>.csv`: distance models (results/specificity_distance_dHCP.csv, specificity_distance_survival_dHCP.csv)

# 1 Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(car)
library(emmeans)

tab_dir <- here::here("outputs", "tables")
```

  setNames(paste("Insula to",  roi_labels), sub("_claustrum_", "_insula_",  names(roi_labels))),

roi_labels_all <- c(roi_labels, roi_labels_ctrl)

## Load data

```{r}
dat_dHCP <- read_delim(
  here::here("data", "dHCP_CP_control_volumes_distance.csv"),
  delim = ";",
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = ","),
  na = c(""," ","NA", "NaN", "n/a", "."),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject_ID = col_character(),
    Session_ID = col_character()
  ),
  guess_max = 10000
) |> janitor::clean_names()

# --- recode and name important factors ---
dat_dHCP <- dat_dHCP %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(case_when(
      group == "term" ~ "FT",
      group == "pre"  ~ "PT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("FT", "PT")),
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )

# --- variable sets ---
cp_vars   <- grep("_claustrum_",            names(dat_dHCP), value = TRUE)
ctrl_vars <- grep("^[lr]_(insula|putamen)_", names(dat_dHCP), value = TRUE)

# --- check data loaded ---
stopifnot(
  nrow(dat_dHCP) == 144, !anyNA(dat_dHCP$group), !anyNA(dat_dHCP$sex),
  length(cp_vars) == 22, setequal(cp_vars, names(roi_labels)),
  length(ctrl_vars) == 44, setequal(ctrl_vars, names(roi_labels_ctrl))
)
```

# 2 Run ANCOVA control analyses for all ROIs

### Specific setup

```{r}
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

stopifnot(is.factor(dat_dHCP$group), is.factor(dat_dHCP$sex), is.numeric(dat_dHCP$scan_age))
```

## A Using control-seed CP as covariate

### ANCOVA helper function

```{r}
# build helper function to run ANCOVA
run_ancova_one <- function(dv){
  fml <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~ group + scan_age + sex"))
  df  <- dat_dHCP[, all.vars(fml)] %>% na.omit()
  if (nrow(df) < 20) return(NULL)
  
  fit <- lm(fml, data = df)
  
  # Type-III ANOVA
  a3  <- car::Anova(fit, type = 3)
  
  # Extract key numbers from the ANOVA table
  a3_df <- as.data.frame(a3)
  a3_df$Term <- rownames(a3_df)
  
  ss_group <- a3_df$`Sum Sq`[a3_df$Term == "group"]
  df_group <- a3_df$Df[a3_df$Term == "group"]
  Fval     <- a3_df$`F value`[a3_df$Term == "group"]
  pval     <- a3_df$`Pr(>F)`[a3_df$Term == "group"]
  
  ss_res   <- a3_df$`Sum Sq`[a3_df$Term == "Residuals"]
  df_res   <- a3_df$Df[a3_df$Term == "Residuals"]
  
  # Partial eta^2
  partial_eta2 <- as.numeric(ss_group / (ss_group + ss_res))
  
  # Estimated marginal means and contrast (FT - PT)
  emm   <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ group)
  comp  <- emmeans::contrast(emm, method = "pairwise") %>% summary(infer = TRUE)
  
  emm_tbl <- as.data.frame(emm)
  mean_FT <- emm_tbl$emmean[emm_tbl$group == "FT"]
  mean_PT <- emm_tbl$emmean[emm_tbl$group == "PT"]
  diff_FT_PT <- comp$estimate[1]  # FT - PT
  
  dir_lab <- if (pval < 0.05) {
    if (diff_FT_PT > 0) "FT > PT" else "PT > FT"
  } else {
    if (diff_FT_PT > 0) "NS (FT > PT)" else "NS (PT > FT)"
  }
  
  f_str <- sprintf("F(1, %d) = %.2f, p = %s",
                   df_res, Fval,
                   ifelse(pval < .001, "< 0.001**",
                          ifelse(pval < .01, sprintf("%.3f*", pval),
                                 sprintf("%.3f", pval))))
  
  tibble(
    dv            = dv,
    ROI           = dplyr::recode(dv, !!!roi_labels_all, .default = dv),
    N             = nrow(df),
    F             = as.numeric(Fval),
    df1           = as.numeric(df_group),
    df2           = as.numeric(df_res),
    p             = as.numeric(pval),
    partial_eta2  = partial_eta2,
    emmean_FT     = as.numeric(mean_FT),
    emmean_PT     = as.numeric(mean_PT),
    diff_FT_minus_PT = as.numeric(diff_FT_PT),
    Direction     = dir_lab,
    F_string      = f_str
  )
}

# helper function to run ANCOVA with matched control-seed covariate
run_ancova_ctrl <- function(dv, control = NULL){
  
  extra <- if (is.null(control)) character(0)
  else vapply(control, \(s) sub("_claustrum_", paste0("_", s, "_"), dv), "")
  
  missing_cols <- setdiff(extra, names(dat_dHCP))
  if (length(missing_cols)) { warning("missing: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse=", ")); return(NULL) }
  
  fml <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~ group + scan_age + sex",
                          if (length(extra)) paste("+", paste(extra, collapse = " + ")) else ""))
  df  <- dat_dHCP[, all.vars(fml)] |> na.omit()
  if (nrow(df) < 20) return(NULL)
  
  fit <- lm(fml, data = df)
  a3  <- as.data.frame(car::Anova(fit, type = 3))
  a3$Term <- rownames(a3)
  
  ss_g <- a3$`Sum Sq`[a3$Term == "group"]
  ss_r <- a3$`Sum Sq`[a3$Term == "Residuals"]
  Fval <- a3$`F value`[a3$Term == "group"]
  pval <- a3$`Pr(>F)`[a3$Term == "group"]
  df_r <- a3$Df[a3$Term == "Residuals"]
  
  emm  <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ group)
  comp <- emmeans::contrast(emm, method = "pairwise") |> summary(infer = TRUE)
  
  # how much the covariate itself explains
  beta_ctrl <- if (length(extra))
    paste(sprintf("%s: b=%.3f, p=%.3f",
                  extra,
                  coef(summary(fit))[extra, "Estimate"],
                  coef(summary(fit))[extra, "Pr(>|t|)"]), collapse = "; ") else NA_character_
  
  tibble(
    dv = dv,
    ROI = dplyr::recode(dv, !!!roi_labels, .default = dv),
    model = if (is.null(control)) "unadjusted" else paste(control, collapse = "+"),
    N = nrow(df), F = as.numeric(Fval), df2 = as.numeric(df_r),
    p = as.numeric(pval),
    partial_eta2 = as.numeric(ss_g / (ss_g + ss_r)),
    diff_FT_minus_PT = comp$estimate[1],
    control_effect = beta_ctrl
  )
}
```

### Test group differences in control seeds

```{r}
res_ctrl <- map_dfr(ctrl_vars, run_ancova_one) |>
  mutate(seed  = if_else(str_detect(dv, "_insula_"), "Insula", "Putamen")) |>
  group_by(seed) |>
  mutate(p_FDR = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(seed, p)

readr::write_excel_csv2(res_ctrl, file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_control_group_diff_dHCP_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
```

### Results of specificity analysis

```{r}
res_spec <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(cp_vars, run_ancova_ctrl, control = NULL),
  map_dfr(cp_vars, run_ancova_ctrl, control = "insula"),
  map_dfr(cp_vars, run_ancova_ctrl, control = "putamen"),
  map_dfr(cp_vars, run_ancova_ctrl, control = c("insula","putamen"))
) |>
  group_by(model) |>
  mutate(p_FDR = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) |>
  ungroup()
```

### Evaluate survival of original findings

```{r}
survival <- res_spec |>
  dplyr::select(ROI, model, F, p, p_FDR, partial_eta2, diff_FT_minus_PT) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model,
              values_from = c(F, p, p_FDR, partial_eta2, diff_FT_minus_PT)) |>
  mutate(
    sig_unadj = p_FDR_unadjusted     < .05,
    sig_ins   = p_FDR_insula         < .05,
    sig_put   = p_FDR_putamen        < .05,
    sig_both  = `p_FDR_insula+putamen` < .05,
    status = case_when(
      sig_unadj &  sig_both ~ "survives full adjustment",
      sig_unadj & (sig_ins | sig_put) ~ "survives single adjustment only",
      sig_unadj ~ "lost after adjustment",
      TRUE ~ "ns unadjusted"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(p_FDR_unadjusted)

# save tables
readr::write_excel_csv2(res_spec, file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_specificity_ANCOVA_CP_dHCP_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
readr::write_excel_csv2(survival, file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_specificity_survival_dHCP_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
```

# B Using seed and target volumes as covariates

### ANCOVA helper function

```{r}
pathway_suffix <- function(dv) sub("^[lr]_claustrum_", "", dv)

stopifnot(
  all(paste0("target_vol_", pathway_suffix(cp_vars)) %in% names(dat_dHCP)),
  all(c("seed_vox_l", "seed_vox_r") %in% names(dat_dHCP))
)

run_ancova_vol <- function(dv, adjust = c("none", "seed", "target", "both")){
  adjust <- match.arg(adjust)
  hemi   <- substr(dv, 1, 1)
  
  d <- dat_dHCP |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      group, scan_age, sex,
      y          = .data[[dv]],
      seed_cov   = .data[[paste0("seed_vox_", hemi)]],
      target_cov = .data[[paste0("target_vol_", pathway_suffix(dv))]]
    )
  
  terms <- c("group", "scan_age", "sex",
             if (adjust %in% c("seed", "both"))   "seed_cov",
             if (adjust %in% c("target", "both")) "target_cov")
  
  d <- d[, c("y", terms)] |> na.omit()
  if (nrow(d) < 20) return(NULL)
  d <- d |>
    dplyr::mutate(group_num = as.numeric(group),
                  dplyr::across(dplyr::any_of(c("seed_cov", "target_cov")),
                                ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))
  
  fit <- lm(reformulate(terms, response = "y"), data = d)
  a3  <- as.data.frame(car::Anova(fit, type = 3))
  a3$Term <- rownames(a3)
  ss_g <- a3$`Sum Sq`[a3$Term == "group"]
  ss_r <- a3$`Sum Sq`[a3$Term == "Residuals"]
  
  cs <- coef(summary(fit))
  cov_stat <- function(term, col) if (term %in% rownames(cs)) cs[term, col] else NA_real_
  
  # how well do the other covariates predict group?
  others <- setdiff(terms, "group")
  vif_g  <- 1 / (1 - summary(lm(reformulate(others, response = "group_num"), data = d))$r.squared)
  
  comp <- emmeans::contrast(emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ group), method = "pairwise") |>
    summary(infer = TRUE)
  
  tibble(
    dv = dv, ROI = dplyr::recode(dv, !!!roi_labels, .default = dv),
    model = adjust, N = nrow(d),
    F = a3$`F value`[a3$Term == "group"], df2 = a3$Df[a3$Term == "Residuals"],
    p = a3$`Pr(>F)`[a3$Term == "group"],
    partial_eta2 = ss_g / (ss_g + ss_r),
    diff_FT_minus_PT = comp$estimate[1],
    beta_seed   = cov_stat("seed_cov",   "Estimate"), p_seed   = cov_stat("seed_cov",   "Pr(>|t|)"),
    beta_target = cov_stat("target_cov", "Estimate"), p_target = cov_stat("target_cov", "Pr(>|t|)"),
    vif_group = vif_g
  )
}
```

### Seed and target volume dependence analysis

```{r}
res_vol <- purrr::map_dfr(c("none", "seed", "target", "both"),
                          \(m) purrr::map_dfr(cp_vars, run_ancova_vol, adjust = m)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(model) |>
  dplyr::mutate(p_FDR = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
```

### Evaluate survival of original findings

```{r}
survival_vol <- res_vol |>
  dplyr::select(ROI, model, p_FDR, diff_FT_minus_PT) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(p_FDR, diff_FT_minus_PT)) |>
  dplyr::filter(p_FDR_none < .05) |>
  dplyr::mutate(sig_seed   = p_FDR_seed   < .05,
                sig_target = p_FDR_target < .05,
                sig_both   = p_FDR_both   < .05,
                effect_retained_both = diff_FT_minus_PT_both / diff_FT_minus_PT_none) |>
  dplyr::arrange(p_FDR_none)

# save tables
readr::write_excel_csv2(res_vol,      file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_specificity_volume_ANCOVA_CP_dHCP_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
readr::write_excel_csv2(survival_vol, file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_specificity_volume_survival_dHCP_",  Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
```

# C Using distance between seed and target ROI as covariates

### ANCOVA helper function

```{r}
stopifnot(all(paste0("dist_", pathway_suffix(cp_vars)) %in% names(dat_dHCP)))

run_ancova_dis <- function(dv, adjust = c("none", "distance")){
  adjust <- match.arg(adjust)
  
  d <- dat_dHCP |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      group, scan_age, sex,
      y            = .data[[dv]],
      distance_cov = .data[[paste0("dist_", pathway_suffix(dv))]]
    )
  
  terms <- c("group", "scan_age", "sex",
             if (adjust == "distance") "distance_cov")
  
  d <- d[, c("y", terms)] |> na.omit()
  if (nrow(d) < 20) return(NULL)
  d <- d |>
    dplyr::mutate(group_num = as.numeric(group),
                  dplyr::across(dplyr::any_of("distance_cov"),
                                ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))
  
  fit <- lm(reformulate(terms, response = "y"), data = d)
  a3  <- as.data.frame(car::Anova(fit, type = 3))
  a3$Term <- rownames(a3)
  ss_g <- a3$`Sum Sq`[a3$Term == "group"]
  ss_r <- a3$`Sum Sq`[a3$Term == "Residuals"]
  
  cs <- coef(summary(fit))
  cov_stat <- function(term, col) if (term %in% rownames(cs)) cs[term, col] else NA_real_
  
  others <- setdiff(terms, "group")
  vif_g  <- 1 / (1 - summary(lm(reformulate(others, response = "group_num"), data = d))$r.squared)
  
  comp <- emmeans::contrast(emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ group), method = "pairwise") |>
    summary(infer = TRUE)
  
  tibble(
    dv = dv, ROI = dplyr::recode(dv, !!!roi_labels, .default = dv),
    model = adjust, N = nrow(d),
    F = a3$`F value`[a3$Term == "group"], df2 = a3$Df[a3$Term == "Residuals"],
    p = a3$`Pr(>F)`[a3$Term == "group"],
    partial_eta2 = ss_g / (ss_g + ss_r),
    diff_FT_minus_PT = comp$estimate[1],
    beta_dist = cov_stat("distance_cov", "Estimate"), p_dist = cov_stat("distance_cov", "Pr(>|t|)"),
    vif_group = vif_g
  )
}
```

### Seed and target distance dependence analysis

```{r}
res_dis <- purrr::map_dfr(c("none", "distance"),
                          \(m) purrr::map_dfr(cp_vars, run_ancova_dis, adjust = m)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(model) |>
  dplyr::mutate(p_FDR = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
```

### Evaluate survival of original findings

```{r}
survival_dis <- res_dis |>
  dplyr::select(ROI, model, p_FDR, diff_FT_minus_PT) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(p_FDR, diff_FT_minus_PT)) |>
  dplyr::filter(p_FDR_none < .05) |>
  dplyr::mutate(sig_distance     = p_FDR_distance < .05,
                effect_retained  = diff_FT_minus_PT_distance / diff_FT_minus_PT_none) |>
  dplyr::arrange(p_FDR_none)
```

### Save outputs

```{r}
readr::write_excel_csv2(res_dis,      file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_specificity_distance_ANCOVA_CP_dHCP_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
readr::write_excel_csv2(survival_dis, file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_specificity_distance_survival_dHCP_",  Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
```
